posts.text:
surprised in the best way to see my friend @mittromney drop in to introduce a talk i was giving in salt lake today. 

we really need more leaders like mitt.

iran and the united states aren’t at all far apart in negotiating positions. 

but there is zero trust (there would be negative trust if that were a thing) and both countries believe they have the stronger position. 

which is why all these announcements of an imminent deal have turned out to be less imminent.
very much enjoyed meeting up with (i hope) the future president of venezuela @mariacorinaya.

despite what your local politicians tell you, the path to higher income for large populations is the services sector, not manufacturing.

v useful dataviz on the long term labor market

an important question from @sineadbovell… which global leaders are best positioned to tackle the future of artificial intelligence?
me: is the pope catholic?

Video
piped.video/watch?v=ldUQ2FsO…
not 100% sure but i don’t think the art of the deal was translated into farsi.

operation epic fury is over. 
can someone tell the iranians that?


Open Source Intel (@Osint613)

Secretary of State Marco Rubio: "The operation is over - Epic Fury. We are done with that stage of it."

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/Osint613/status/2051752553860284685#m

talking tech-lash, trump’s failing political revolution, and the parallels between the gilded age and now…
with @sineadbovell

Video
piped.video/watch?v=ldUQ2FsO…

the “least worst” option is ending this war. 
not clear washington is ready to take it.
@gzeromedia

Video

us announces “project freedom" and sends destroyers into the strait. iran responds with missiles and drones.
that’s not a misunderstanding, that’s strategy.
@gzeromedia

Video

trump’s ‘project freedom’
sounds decisive.
in practice?
no escorts. no reopening.
just a softer approach to a hard problem.
@gzeromedia

Video

project freedom update:
strait of hormuz remains closed

trump's ‘project freedom’
meant reopening shipping lanes.
what it became:
mapping mines, avoiding escalation, and asking others to help.
@gzeromedia

Video

a strange game, uno. 
the only winning move is not to play.

iranians willing to continue to use force to keep strait closed. 

today showing readiness to return to war and impose new costs if current status quo continues.
brexit: who knew?
i think it’s hard when people conflate analysis with what they want.
i won’t interview tucker carlson or appear on his show. too many instances of disinformation and bad faith to merit platforming in my view.
